title: Ghost Marriage in China
synopsis: Ghost marriages are an old custom dating back to the Shang dynasty. In Shanxi province, some people still hold on to it.

fullText.simplified:
中国冥婚习俗

    在山西省，有一种奇特的习俗叫冥婚。在当地的一些农村地区，如果未婚男子不幸去世，他的父母会想办法买“门当户对”的未婚女子的尸体，把两人的尸体合葬在一起，并举办婚宴酒席，意思是这两个人在阴间结婚了。
    但是，由于在山西，男子的死亡率比女子高，所以很难找到合适的女尸。有些人需要等几年才能等到。因此一具年轻女尸的价格常常高达十几万，甚至几十万。
    冥婚在中国有很悠久的历史。早在商朝就有这种习俗，到唐代开始兴盛，至今仍在山西部分地区盛行。冥婚现象在古代的希腊和日本等国都曾经存在过，可是都逐渐衰退或者消亡了。只有中国，冥婚随着社会经济的发展而更加兴盛。
fullText.traditional:
中國冥婚習俗

    在山西省，有一種奇特的習俗叫冥婚。在當地的一些農村地區，如果未婚男子不幸去世，他的父母會想辦法買“門當戶對”的未婚女子的屍體，把兩人的屍體合葬在一起，並舉辦婚宴酒席，意思是這兩個人在陰間結婚了。
    但是，由於在山西，男子的死亡率比女子高，所以很難找到合適的女屍。有些人需要等幾年才能等到。因此一具年輕女屍的價格常常高達十幾萬，甚至幾十萬。
    冥婚在中國有很悠久的歷史。早在商朝就有這種習俗，到唐代開始興盛，至今仍在山西部分地區盛行。冥婚現象在古代的希臘和日本等國都曾經存在過，可是都逐漸衰退或者消亡了。只有中國，冥婚隨著社會經濟的發展而更加興盛。

The custom has only survived in China, where it nowadays has become more and more prosperous due to recent economic developments.

raw.synopsis: Ghost marriages are an old custom dating back to the Shang dynasty. In Shanxi province, some people still hold on to it.
sentence_translations: There’s a special custom in Shanxi province called ghost marriage.
In the suburb areas of Shanxi, if an unmarried young male dies, ..
.. his parents will try hard to buy the corpse of a suitable unmarried girl.
The families will bury the corpses together and hold a wedding banquet, meaning the two will get married after death.
However, in Shanxi the male death rate is higher than the female.
It’s hard to find suitable female corpses and some families need to wait for years.
The price of a young female corpse could therefore be over 100 thousand RMB, some people might even pay several hundred thousand.
Ghost marriage has a long history in China.
This custom began during the Shang dynasty and flourished in the Tang Dynasty. Today it is mainly popular in some areas of Shanxi.
Ghost marriage used to exist during the ancient time in Greece and Japan but gradually declined or disappeared.
The custom has only survived in China, where it nowadays has become more and more prosperous due to recent economic developments.
